title: Comparison as a procedure of its own
statement: Whether comparison should be taught as a procedure of its own, holding one named dimension and building each side in full before comparing, is still only a proposal.
detail: Two documents in the reading course renderer propose a comparison procedure for grades 4 and 5, where comparing two texts starts to be asked for and no procedure existed: read the question, name one dimension and hold it, build each side's evidence on that dimension, finishing one side before starting the other, then state the likeness, the difference and what it means (`grade3-reading/course-renderer/docs/pedagogy/modelling-moment-procedures-g4-g5.md`; `grade3-reading/course-renderer/docs/pedagogy/grade5-procedure-proposal.md`). The grade 5 version rejects a true but irrelevant detail or a comparison that changes dimension halfway, and the correction table says a learner who cannot find a difference has usually never built one of the two columns. Both are proposals awaiting sign-off, and a grade 5 lesson plan lists the procedure as documented but unsigned (`grade3-reading/course-renderer/content/lesson-plans/g5-u1-l7.json`, line 45). Nothing has measured it with learners.

evidence.quote: summarizing a longer text and comparing two texts start to be asked for at Grade 4 and neither had a procedure to run.

| 2 | Name the dimension | "On WHAT am I comparing them? One dimension at a time." | | 3 | Build each side | "What does the text say about each one, on that dimension? I build one column at a time, and I finish one side completely before I start the other." |
Build each side: select evidence for both sides on that dimension. Reject a true but irrelevant detail or a comparison that changes dimensions halfway through.
| Cannot find a difference | Return to Step 3: "Tell me about A. Now tell me about B." (Usually one column was never built.) |
Treat the seven Grade 3 procedures as settled and these two as open to being rewritten or rejected.
The two additions below require explicit sign-off before merge.
CANDIDATE: COMPARE, documented but unsigned and not in renderer union
